name: OC plus speaker-conditioned positive BPL1 plus conservative duration-consistency BPL2
core_hypothesis: Keep discrimination on original long-input OC; use speaker-matched cross-utterance normal positives for nuisance robustness and same-source nested positives for duration/repetition robustness without a large population of synthetic short OC inputs.

locked_for_first_comparison.code_reference: original240 architecture and OC semantics, git10f3bcd; common new runner for all arms, never compare a rewritten trainer causally to historical weights alone
locked_for_first_comparison.OC_short_source_policy: Retain original wrap to64600 only in main OC/reference; do not remove repetition globally simultaneously with pair changes. This is a conservative experimental anchor, not a claim repetition is optimal.
locked_for_first_comparison.OC_source_order: Original class DistributedSampler/smallloader cycling and partial batches, same UID order in all arms. Do not switch to speaker-balanced OC batches.
locked_for_first_comparison.OC_augmentation: Original RawBoost0-8 and original order; codec off; no speed/tempo augmentation in first study
locked_for_first_comparison.backend: Original160dim and OC center; no projection, speaker classifier, EMA teacher or new inference module
locked_for_first_comparison.optimizer: Original backend then bona-only center Adam,2calls/logicalstep; lr1e-5; same scheduler andRNGstreams across arms

pair_math.original_local_BPL: mean of all12x12 long-normal x short-normal pairs
pair_math.critical_correction: Permuting the same two full sets leaves the all-pairs scalar unchanged. Define per-anchor selected pairs or masks/group-scoped BPL calls. Retain ell, change admissible pairs.
pair_math.first_prototype_pair_count: One positive counterpart per normal anchor for each active BPL branch; up to12BPL1 and12BPL2 pairs/GPU; normalize each loss by its own valid anchors. Not144independent source pairs.
pair_math.partial_and_skipped_pairs: Use global valid-count normalization across ranks; inactive examples remain in OC, never alter OC class quotas. No hidden duplication or substitute different-speaker pair for a missing same-speaker pair.

BPL1.positive_sources: Same speaker, different original UID, both bonafide; no speaker-negative or spoof-positive pairs
BPL1.duration_control: Both network inputs64600 samples. Also match unique-content length U=min(original_samples,64600): min(Ui,Uj)/max(Ui,Uj)>=0.8, to limit repetition-degree confounding.
BPL1.sampling: For each OC bona anchor choose one eligible same-speaker peer with a separate deterministic RNG. Do not regroup OC anchors. Allow shared right-side peers across anchors only when necessary, record multiplicities.
BPL1.augmentation: Independent original RawBoost draws on the two inputs; no codec transformation
BPL1.normalization: Mean over active anchors, not over speaker group cardinalities
BPL1.if_no_peer: Skip only BPL1 for that anchor; retain its OC and BPL2 eligibility
BPL1.hypothesis: Reduce within-speaker variation induced by utterance content, recording conditions and augmentation; not guaranteed to learn noise invariance or to suppress speaker identity.
BPL1.risk: Speaker-specific clusters/channel shortcuts; original common OC center provides cross-speaker classification constraint but no guarantee of invariance. Measure held-out-utterance speaker probes and cross-speaker normal geometry.
BPL1.train_metadata_feasibility: pair_feasibility.json:2579/2580haveeligiblepeer; one has none; median77peers;2557have>=12peers. Speech-content/VAD eligibility not yet tested.

BPL2.positive_sources: Same bona original UID, same anchor source interval; never arbitrary different utterances solely because their durations differ
BPL2.reference: The long OC bona embedding already computed for64600samples; this reference can contain wrapping for naturally short sources.
BPL2.unique_content_base: U=min(original_samples,64600); use only the first unique source interval, never sample a student crop across an artificial wrap boundary.
BPL2.longer_original_policy: If U>=32000samples, draw r uniformly[0.8,0.9], make a contiguous nested crop of ceil(r*U) samples, randomly position it inside the unique interval. Student uses native actual length and proper frontend/backend masks; never wrap the student.
BPL2.native_short_policy: If U<32000samples, student is the entire unique native input, retention100%; no further synthetic shortening. A1.2s original remains1.2s as student and remains in fixed4.0375s OC reference.
BPL2.augmentation_control: Initial version crops the already-augmented OC first unique interval. This preserves overlapping augmented waveform samples exactly and isolates context/length more than independently reaugmenting the student; do not change the original OC augmentation order. Independent student augmentation is a later separate ablation.
BPL2.speech_content_guard_proposed: VAD used only to accept nested crops, never to trim audio or alter OC sampler: require >=80% of reference unique-interval voiced frames retained; if no eligible crop, skip that BPL2 crop. Geometric80-90% retention does not itself guarantee phonetic-information retention. Actual VAD acceptance rates require Train-only preflight.
BPL2.gradient: ell(stop_gradient(z_long),z_student). Original scalar formula is retained; reverse path changes. There is no independent frozen teacher: weights are shared, so student updates can still affect later long embeddings.
BPL2.hypothesis: Encourage naturally short/reduced-context bona to align with its long normal reference, reducing duration/repetition-conditioned score offsets while preserving long discrimination.
limits: For U<cap the pair changes both effective duration and repetition; not pure periodicity isolation
Shortening cannot recover information absent from the student
Stop-gradient avoids direct long-side BPL2 gradient but does not guarantee no degradation
Positive-only consistency alone can contract representation; retain OC and test spoof separation

final_objective.coefficient_status: Proposed conservative initial values, not validated optimum; sum equals original BPL coefficient1 but gradient magnitudes are not thereby equal.
final_objective.center_step: Retain original bona-only OC center update; no BPL update to center
final_objective.common_warmup: Epochs1-5allarms use original BPL144. Epochs6-10 linearly blend original BPL144 to each arm target; epochs11-50 use target. Common prefix from a newly audited checkpoint with full optimizer/sampler/RNG state; do not reuse failed mildv2 memory/no checkpoint.

views_per_gpu.note: Extra views are not extra OC samples or optimizer steps. Historical implementation also forwards unused spoof short views; equalize the common runner and report actual waveforms/seconds/memory rather than call all these counts batch240.

controlled_training_arms_proposed.purpose: Reproduced current reference with common runner

controlled_training_arms_proposed.target_BPL: Originalsameviews, one random normal counterpart per anchor,12pairs
controlled_training_arms_proposed.purpose: Control reduced pair count/weighting independently of speaker and duration design

hypothesis_tests.H1: B versusA12: normal perturbation sensitivity decreases without increased speaker/channel-specific failures; no claim from positive cosine alone.
hypothesis_tests.H2: C versusA12: native-short normal rejection and paired wrap/native gaps decrease, without raising A10/A11spoof misses.
hypothesis_tests.interaction: D improvement beyond individual replacements supports complementarity; if D only follows one branch, retain the simpler method.
BPL2_mechanism_followups: Stop-gradient versus both-sided gradient at fixed crop and weights
Information-preserving80-90% versus one deliberately shorter setting, only as a separate controlled ablation
Same-speaker BPL1 versus different-speaker bona positives with matched durations/augmentation, if speaker leakage grows
hypothesis_tests.causal_training_origin: Frozen repetition probes and length matching do not prove how a shortcut was learned. A separate class-duration/repetition randomized training study is needed for that claim.

evaluation_proposed.checkpoints: Save5,10,...50 before evaluation. Report minimum EER and epoch separately per dataset per user preference, also preset50. Target minima are retrospective/oracle results, not independent deployment model selection.
evaluation_proposed.inputs: Common fixed prefix64600cap; report both native-no-repeat/masked and fixed-wrap4 as prespecified separate policies for every model, no choosing per-model or per-length winners
evaluation_proposed.official_scoring: Each trained OCcenter cosine, common seed1729/batch8/original ASPnoise1e-5; mechanism probesnoise0 labeled separately
cuts: original<=1,1-1.5,1.5-2,2-3,3-4.0375,>4.0375seconds; noEER where a class is absent
codec and speaker strata, bona FRR and spoof FAR separately
paired normal noise sensitivity, unit-embedding covariance/effective rank and two-class separation, not only loss or collapsed normal variance
Train-fit speaker/duration diagnostic probes split by UID before any augmentation, no same-source leakage
evaluation_proposed.error_thresholds: For no-dev diagnostics use explicitly labeled native-eval EER point held fixed across paired input conditions; never claim deployment calibration. ROC-based per-bin EER/FRR-at-fixed-FAR also reported.
evaluation_proposed.replication: Seed1 exploratory screen; repeat selected arms under >=3matched seeds before generalization claims. Existing21LA repeatedly inspected; definitive confirmation requires a new untouched source.

execution_guards_proposed: No new training or server/GPU job authorized by this design task
Actual Train pair/VAD acceptance preflight; never assume all gates feasible
Real spawn worker evaluation smoke with full module import path, not just parent/stub tests
Atomic CLS/TrainState before any evaluation to preserve completed training if evaluator fails
Unique result roots, immutable snapshots/hashes, bounded timeout, fail fast and no automatic retries

cost_scope.future_training: Not launched. Estimate total all arms/seeds/evaluation and obtain approval if cumulative new cost could reach10USD before execution.
cost_scope.cleanup: Only local derived metadata/spec artifacts created; no new long-running processes or paid resources.

evidence_status: This is a justified testable final candidate, not a trained winner. New full21LA repetition/dose experiment still pending; constants, stop-gradient, and crop/VAD gates are proposals.
